page.layout: One column of text, with a decorative head ornament at the top and no marginal notes. Top: a printed woodcut ornament (not text), then the title block, then the work heading with its Deuteronomy reference and the Argumentum heading, then four paragraphs of running text. Catchword "In" at the lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.head: SEQVVNTVR ALIQVOT SACRÆ SCRIPTVRÆ CANTICA, Lyricis quoque versibus ab eodem IOANNE IACOMOTO Barrensi expressa.
CANTICVM MOSIS, EX Deuteronom. CAP. 32.
ARGVMENTVM.
main_text.p: EXCELLENTISSIMVM hoc Mosis Canticum in quinque partes præcipuas diuisimus eásque diuersis versuum generibus exprimere conati sumus.
In prima parte Moses beneficia illa commemorat quæ populus Israeliticus à Deo acceperat.
In secunda eiusdem populi animũ ingratum erga Deum, tantorúmque bene-ficiorum authorem reprehendit.

page.notes: The top ornament is a printer's decorative border and is not transcribed. Faint ghosted text on the right side of the page is show-through from the reverse and is excluded. The initial "E" of "EXCELLENTISSIMVM" is a large decorative initial, joined to the following capitals. The mark after "bene" is a printed line-end hyphen rendered as a dot, so it is read as a hyphen. The catchword "In" at the lower right is taken as the catchword.
